text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around the academy…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I've been workin' on the raaailroad, aaall the livelong day. ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh! Hey, Trainer! Out getting some nice, fresh air over your gills today?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For some reason, Gold Ship is in her signature racewear.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This? Actually, I just did battle with a massive tuna, and boy, was it tough.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heroes always wear red, so here I am, channeling some of that red hero energy to myself!
choice_data_list: Is hero energy even a thing?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon, Trainer! Don't tell me you don't know about the ultimate power of the color red!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Think back to the Saturday morning cartoons you watched as a kid. You know, the ones about good versus evil? Now, what color did the main character always wear, hm?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ding, ding, ding! That's right! Red. The strongest, bestest hero always wears red and always wins. That's how the system works.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So why the heck wouldn't I pick the red outfit when I get the chance?! I'm guaranteed to win if I do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't quite follow her logic, but she seems to have it all figured out.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, it's high time I set sail to find my next fishy opponent…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just when Gold Ship turns to leave…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dun-dun!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh. Hold it right there. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I believe I just heard you claim that red is a hero's color… but what makes you so sure?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, two incredibly intimidating Umamusume block Gold Ship's path!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Holy cannoli! Maruzen and Pearl?! What're you two doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Red just happens to be our color too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: While many heroes do wear red, that isn't red's only charm.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Doesn't the sight of it stir your heart? Don't you feel a mature allure?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohoho! Why, red is the choice hue for a femme fatale. It's the color of dangerous beauty!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now tell me… Don't you want a taste of what it's like to live on the edge?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Guh! Their villain vibes are off the charts!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So much for my iron-clad dissertation on why red's the color of heroes!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Help me, Trainer! What's the truth here?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Help me, Trainer! What's the truth here?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So that's how it is… All this time, I've underestimated the power of red.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The reality is, red always had the potential to be a hero… or a villain.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh? This is new. Are you really accepting the truth without making a fuss?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yes, I give. Gone are the days of my childish rebellion. I've matured.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! You're all grown up now, are you? No worries, dear. We'll show you the ropes of being an adult. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So many new discoveries await you now that you've taken your first step into adulthood.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But it's all right. Everyone is nervous at first, but there's nothing to fear. Come, we'll guide you well.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I-it's time for me to become a true adult… I'll see you on the other side, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Everyone has to grow up someday. My time just happens to be today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: My, the sky sure is beautiful today. I sure hope it'll be sunny again tomorrow… Haha…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Somehow, Gold Ship's eyes seem a bit emptier than before. Her first step into adulthood has evidently aged her beyond her years.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah… You're exactly right!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll make these two see that red is the power of heroes if it's the last thing I do!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Heh. Was that a challenge? Do you really think you can defeat us?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohoho! You had better not hold anything back!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wasn't plannin' to! Ready or not, here I cooome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship steps up boldly, just like a real hero!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But ten minutes later…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huff… Wheeze!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I can do this all day. ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: N-nothing's working… They're too powerful!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: But… I won't give up! Here comes my finishing move! Super-Mega-Ultra BEEEAM!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship unleashes her ultimate attack! Unfortunately…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Oh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: My eyes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's beam hits Seeking the Pearl's sunglasses, reflects off them, and shines right back in her own face.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I'll prove that red is for heroes someday, you mark my words… Bluuergh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship collapses, but her determination remains staunch. Her persistence will surely pay off… someday.
